# The tools that make the release's packages, each pinned by the hash of its universal wheel, and nothing else:
#     python -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all: -r .github/security/build-requirements.txt
#     python -m build --no-isolation
# build makes the source archive and the wheel from it; hatchling is pyproject.toml's build backend, the rest is what
